newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 18.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Washington issues a new warning to Iraq as U.S. sends more troops to the Gulf.
- Abu Dhabi will host an international trade and financial conference next October to boost investment in the region.
- Traders in Dubai say Dubai and Sharjah have exported two billion dirhams worth of goods to Iraq since the beginning of 1996.
- Some dhow operators are allegedly bringing dates from Iraq, breaking U.N. sanctions.
- An amnesty scheme for illegal workers in the UAE to return home may slow the country's economic growth, push inflation higher and reduce competitiveness in the short term.
- Kuwait in a bid to rally Arab support.
- Small businesses and construction sector are hit by a staff shortage as many of the UAE's illegal aliens are set to leave the country under a special government amnesty.
- No talk yet in OPEC of oil output hikes.
- Microsoft plans to launch an Arabic version of its browser, Internet Explorer, in the near future, a company official said.
